NBA DFS Picks for Sunday, October 25 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 4 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 25, 7:18 PM ET

Cade Cunningham (DET) is the top-projected player on the Sunday, October 25 DraftKings main slate at 51.5 DraftKings points for $9,500. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 47.8, $10,100) and Jaylen Brown (PHI, 46.0, $7,900) are next.

Paul Reed (DET) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 8.93 projected points per $1,000 at $4,200.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 25, 7:18 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
